outcome: A double-faced permanent transforms to its other face; a permanent that is not double-faced does not.
Transforming does not fire triggers for turning a permanent face up or face down.
Transforming a permanent that is not double-faced does nothing.
Transforming a permanent whose other face is an instant or sorcery does nothing.
A 'transforms into' trigger fires on a transform or convert when the new face has the stated characteristic.
A transform instruction from an ability is ignored if the permanent transformed or converted since the ability was put on the stack or created.
